points.description: Names about three quarters of the listed factors (about 4–5 of the 6): wind speed, temperature (of water and air), vapour pressure, atmospheric pressure, heat storage in the water body, water quality. Any wording or clear synonym is accepted (e.g. humidity for vapour pressure, salinity/dissolved salts for water quality).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if about two or three correct factors are given.

rubric.notes: Give 2 marks if the student lists roughly four or more of the six factors (wind speed, temperature, vapour pressure, atmospheric pressure, heat storage, water quality) in any wording. Give 1 mark for two or three correct factors. Give 0 for none or unrelated answers. Extra wrong remarks do not cost marks.
